description: React component for displaying and managing a permissions scheme summary in the Mattermost admin console, including editing and deletion functionalities with confirmation modal.

classes.name: PermissionsSchemeSummary
classes.description: React component class for rendering a permissions scheme summary with edit and delete options, including confirmation modal handling.

methods.name: renderConfirmModal
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal for deleting a scheme, including handling server errors and loading state.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops event propagation to prevent parent click handlers from firing.

methods.name: handleDeleteCanceled
methods.description: Handles cancellation of delete action, hiding the confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirmed
methods.description: Performs the delete action asynchronously, updating state based on success or error.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Initiates the delete confirmation modal unless disabled.

methods.name: goToEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the edit page for the current scheme.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method displaying scheme details, associated teams, and action buttons.
